bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The signal is quiet. You earned the rifle.

bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Nadir is yours now. Make it mean something.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The forge is cooling. Take the cutter.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: No more orders. No more heat. You can go.

bosses.speaker: hyperion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: I can finally breathe. Take the weapon.

bosses.speaker: hyperion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The chamber is open. Let the others out.

bosses.speaker: electra
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: I did not see this ending. The rifle is yours.

bosses.speaker: electra
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: One choice was still yours to make.

bosses.speaker: atlas
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The pressure is gone. Keep the core stable.

bosses.speaker: atlas
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: That is enough. Let the chamber rest.

bosses.speaker: orion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Keep the last record. The rail is yours.

bosses.speaker: orion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Remember that someone was here.

bosses.speaker: pandora
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The ice is breaking. Take the weapon.

bosses.speaker: pandora
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Keep moving. The cold will not wait.

bosses.speaker: hermes
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The noise is gone. Choose your own route.

bosses.speaker: hermes
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: At last, a clear channel. You can leave.

bosses.speaker: zeus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The supports are failing. Take the cannon and run.

bosses.speaker: zeus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: That was the last load I could carry.

bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: I thought this place would outlast us. I was wrong.

bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Take the rifle. Finish what I could not.

bosses.speaker: luna
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Keep this memory. The Echo lance is yours.

bosses.speaker: luna
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The vault is open. Do not leave them forgotten.

bosses.speaker: mars
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The line is clear. Take the cannon.

bosses.speaker: mars
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: For once, there is no next train.

bosses.speaker: odysseus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The tide is falling. Take the weapon and climb.

bosses.speaker: odysseus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The hull is quiet. Get above the water.

bosses.speaker: athena
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The light is fading. The rifle is yours.

bosses.speaker: athena
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: You found the one angle I could not hold.

bosses.speaker: jupiter
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The field is down. Take the cannon.

bosses.speaker: jupiter
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Everything is still. I had forgotten that sound.

bosses.speaker: vesta
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The last brood is yours to command.

bosses.speaker: vesta
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The bays are empty. Let the small ones go.

bosses.speaker: cora
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The roots are still here. Take what you need.

bosses.speaker: cora
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: You cut the voice. The growth will sleep.

bosses.speaker: apollo
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The uplink is quiet. The sky is yours.

bosses.speaker: apollo
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Take the launcher. Choose where it points.

bosses.speaker: pluto
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: You win. Take the good parts.

bosses.speaker: pluto
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Leave the rest. It was all scrap anyway.

bosses.speaker: theia
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The shadows are still. Take the weapon.

bosses.speaker: theia
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: You found me. There is nothing left to hide.

bosses.speaker: arcas
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Containment is holding. Take the cannon.

bosses.speaker: arcas
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The light is dimming. Keep the core alive.

bosses.speaker: janus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: Pressure released. Take the launcher and go.

bosses.speaker: janus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The water is settling. Get to the surface.

bosses.speaker: minerva
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: This second belongs to you. Take the weapon.

bosses.speaker: minerva
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: No more repeats. Make the next moment count.

bosses.speaker: helena
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The shell is broken. Take the cannon.

bosses.speaker: helena
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The frost is lifting. Do not look back.

bosses.speaker: hyperion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: You earned the last weapon. Carry it out.

bosses.speaker: hyperion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
bosses.text: The command is yours. End this place.
